privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Civic Education RSS respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect your information.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect account details you provide (name, email, phone), learning activity (articles read, quiz results), and technical data such as browser type and IP address for security and service delivery.

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used to provide civic education services, personalize your experience, send optional notifications, and improve platform security. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Organization accounts
sections.body: If you belong to an organization on the platform, administrators of that organization may view membership and learning progress within their workspace, subject to their own policies.

sections.title: Data retention & security
sections.body: We retain account data while your account is active. Organization activity logs are retained according to each institution's audit retention setting (default 365 days). Passwords are hashed, sessions use secure tokens, and privileged accounts require multi-factor authentication. You may download your data or request account deactivation from your profile.

sections.title: AI tutor
sections.body: When you use the AI civic tutor, your questions and recent conversation context are processed to generate answers grounded in published platform content. Tutor chats may be stored temporarily to support session continuity. Do not share passwords or sensitive personal data in tutor messages.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent using the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using the Civic Education RSS, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use the platform for lawful civic education and community discussion. Do not post hate speech, misinformation intended to harm, spam, or content that violates the rights of others.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. Organization owners are responsible for managing members and content published under their workspace.

sections.title: Content
sections.body: Articles, quizzes, and forum posts may be moderated. Organization-published content remains the responsibility of that organization. The platform may remove content that violates these terms.

sections.title: Service availability
sections.body: We strive for reliable access including offline reading where supported, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Features may change as the platform evolves.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The platform is provided for educational purposes. It does not constitute legal advice. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, use the Contact page.
